# Fairytale / OmniAnalytics

> OmniAnalytics is a unified engineering workspace for planning, building, shipping, and operating software.

- https://fairytale.omixsystems.store/

## Crawler guidance
The authenticated dashboard, project data, settings, profiles, and other protected application routes are not listed because they require authentication.
